description: Build a live-show watchdog: a Switch TOP (blend=1 cross-dissolve) between a primary source TOP (NDI/camera/Spout/Syphon path, or a synthetic noiseTOP when none is given) and an MP4 fallback (or a constantTOP when no file is given), driven by an Info CHOP + watchdog CHOP-Execute DAT that trips on cook stall (total_cooks delta stays flat for stall_ms) and, optionally, primary cook errors. A Filter CHOP smooths the integer Switch index into a fade_ms crossfade. Sticky-recover auto-returns to primary after recover_ms healthy; otherwise stays on fallback until Reset. Exposes Active / Stall_Ms / Fade_Ms / Sticky_Recover / Reset / Force_Fallback controls and a Null CHOP of status channels for bind_to_channel. Returns the container, output TOP, status CHOP, control names, and the operator paths.

fade_ms.description: Crossfade duration in ms (0 = hard cut). Drives the Filter CHOP that smooths the Switch TOP index.

fallback_file.description: Filesystem path to the fallback MP4 / still. Empty → a constantTOP (dark grey) is used as a safe fallback.

parent_path.description: Where to create the show_failover system container.

primary_path.description: Absolute TD path to the primary source TOP (NDI/camera/Spout/Syphon/any TOP). Empty → builds a synthetic noiseTOP so the network is offline-safe.

recover_ms.description: Healthy duration before auto-recover (only used when sticky_recover=true).

stall_ms.description: Consecutive ms of zero cook progress before failover trips.

status_overlay.description: Composite a small LIVE/FALLBACK badge (textTOP + compTOP) into the output.

sticky_recover.description: When true, auto-switch back to primary after `recover_ms` of healthy cooking. When false, stays on fallback until Reset is pressed.

watch_errors.description: Also trip on primary cook errors (`errors > 0`), not just on stall.
